title: Patient1 GEX Pre-treatment Baseline
extract_protocol_ch1: Whole blood was collected in a Beckton Dickenson Vacutainer with 158 USP units sodium heparin. Blood was centrifuged at 1500 G for 10 minutes to separate cells from plasma. Plasma was collected and stored at -80 degrees Celsius. The cellular fraction was resuspended in 3-times the original blood volume and overlaid onto Ficoll-Paque PLUS (GE Healthcare Life Sciences). PBMC were separated from red blood cells by centrifugation at 2000 RPM for 30 minutes. The PBMC fraction was removed, washed 2-times in phosphate buffered saline (PBS), resuspended in freezing media consisting of 10% DMSO, 40% fetal bovine serum, 50% RPMI 1640 media (Gibco), frozen gradually at -80°C and then stored in liquid nitrogen prior to analysis. PBMCs were sorted to at least 99% purity based on CD8+ and CD4+ staining using a BD FACSAria III (BD Biosciences).

Library was performed according to the manufacter’s instructions (single cell 5’ protocol, 10x Genomics). Briefly, cells were resuspended in the master mix and loaded together with partitioning oil and gel beads into the chip to generate the gel bead-in-emulsion (GEM). The poly-A RNA from the cell lysate contained in every single GEM was reverse transcribed to cDNA. The pooled barcoded cDNA was then cleaned up with Silane DynaBeads and amplified by PCR. One fraction of the amplified cDNA was used for gene expression library construction and another fraction of the amplified cDNA was further amplified to enrich T cell receptor sequences and used for TCR library construction.
data_processing: The read alignment, barcode processing, and gene counting was performed using the 10X Genomics Cell Ranger 5.0.1 software.
